results.caption:
First guest at Riyadh Air Hafawa Lounge for Business Class at Riyadh Airport

A few weeks ago, I had the privilege of flying on the inaugural Riyadh Air flight from King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh to London Heathrow Airport. It also happened to be the opening day of the brand new Riyadh Air Hafawa Business Class Lounge, and, incredibly, I became its very first guest.

Walking into the lounge for the first time, I was welcomed with traditional Saudi coffee and dates before exploring one of the most beautifully designed airport lounges I’ve visited. The design is elegant, minimal, modern, and unmistakably Saudi.

The lounge is divided into several unique spaces. There are relaxing lounge areas with massage chairs, private suites for resting, a premium à la carte dining room serving restaurant quality cuisine, a generous buffet for lighter meals and snacks, luxury shower facilities, a spa, an immersive Experience Suite showcasing Riyadh Air’s signature beverages, and even a hidden speakeasy style room that deserves a reel of its own.

I spent several hours dining, relaxing, and exploring before boarding my flight to London Heathrow, and I genuinely didn’t want to leave.

For a brand new airline, Riyadh Air has set an incredibly high standard. The quality of the facilities rivals some of the world’s leading premium lounges like Qatar’s Al Mourjan in Doha and the Emirates First Class lounge in Dubai, and the food was easily among the best airport lounge dining experiences I’ve had in a very long time.
